import numpy as np
from collections import Counter as Ct
pairs=[(np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']),np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])) for k in range(1,9)]
def f(ki):
    cnt=Ct(ki.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]; H,W=ki.shape; out=ki.copy()
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if ki[i][j]!=cnt: continue
            cands=[(abs(a-i)+abs(b-j),int(ki[a][b])) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if ki[a][b]!=cnt]
            dmin=min(c[0] for c in cands)
            bests=list(set(c[1] for c in cands if c[0]==dmin))
            out[i][j]=bests[0] if len(bests)==1 else 2
    return out
allok=True
for k,(ki,o) in enumerate(pairs):
    r=f(ki); bad=int((r!=o).sum())
    allok&=(bad==0)
    print('pair',k+1,'mism',bad)
print('OK' if allok else 'FAIL')

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); pairs=[(np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']),np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])) for k in range(1,9)]

def f(ki):
